# Ascension perks — synthetic fixture for testing

ap_one_vision = {
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_one_vision }
	}
	possible = {
		always = yes
	}
	modifier = {
		pop_government_ethic_attraction = 0.15
		council_agenda_progress_speed = 0.20
	}
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}

ap_mind_over_matter = {
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_mind_over_matter }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_engineered_evolution }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_synthetic_evolution }
	}
	possible = {
		NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
	}
	required_traditions = 3
	excluded_perks = { ap_engineered_evolution ap_synthetic_evolution }
	modifier = {
		pop_amenities_usage_no_happiness = -0.10
	}
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = {
		weight = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 0.0
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_materialist
		}
	}
}

ap_synthetic_evolution = {
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_synthetic_evolution }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_mind_over_matter }
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_engineered_evolution }
	}
	possible = {
		NOT = { has_ethic = ethic_gestalt_consciousness }
		has_technology = tech_neural_implants
	}
	required_traditions = 3
	excluded_perks = { ap_mind_over_matter ap_engineered_evolution }
	modifier = {
		pop_robotic_production_mult = 0.15
		robot_pop_assembly_speed = 0.25
	}
	on_enabled = { }
	ai_weight = {
		weight = 1
		modifier = {
			factor = 2.0
			has_ethic = ethic_fanatic_materialist
		}
	}
}

ap_galactic_wonders = {
	potential = {
		NOT = { has_ascension_perk = ap_galactic_wonders }
		has_ascension_perk = ap_mega_engineering
	}
	possible = {
		has_technology = tech_mega_engineering
	}
	required_traditions = 6
	required_perks = { ap_mega_engineering }
	modifier = { }
	on_enabled = {
		allow_megastructure = megastructure_dyson_sphere
		allow_megastructure = megastructure_ring_world
	}
	ai_weight = { weight = 1 }
}
